name: Tele-MANAS Mental Health Helpline 14416
department: Public Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
beneficiary: Students, youth, and citizens seeking psychological support or mental well-being counseling
benefits: Free, confidential counseling services and tele-consultation with mental health experts.
eligibility: Any individual seeking mental health guidance or distress support
application_process: Dial 14416 or 1800-891-4416 to connect with a trained mental health counselor.
